next_step_summary: PR #224 defines the model-neutral bounded OCR worker contract before any Surya or provider implementation. The product owner explicitly skips a separate Android preprocessing device-smoke at this point: destructive crop is removed, grayscale application was already observed, small deskew is not meaningfully judgeable in the current reduced preview, and the available real contract-photo sample is generally well captured. This is a prioritization decision, not a claim of exhaustive device validation; concrete preprocessing defects can reopen that track. Grayscale remains a current implementation detail and is not an active optimization question. The worker contract treats raw OCR text/layout as a transient internal result, defines explicit job/page failure semantics including partial failure, and forbids treating raw OCR as a retained provider/client result. After merge, implement surya-serverless-benchmark-worker-v1 against the contract using only synthetic, public, or owner-controlled redacted benchmark material, with bounded resources and no Android upload, production provider authorization, PII pipeline, Gemini integration, or production data-flow claim.
